name: turn-meter
description: A dim line under each reply: context fill, the turn's tokens and dollars, and its share of the five-hour and weekly limits, priced per point model by model: learned from live readings, started from limit-test's measurements.

showContext.title: Context
showContext.description: ctx 21% · 212k: how full this session's context window is.

showTokens.title: Turn tokens
showTokens.description: The main loop's output, cache writes and cache reads this turn.

showInput.title: Uncached input
showInput.description: Add uncached input tokens to the token groups.

showSubagents.title: Subagents
showSubagents.description: Subagents that finished during the turn, as a group of their own.

showLimits.title: Share of the limits
showLimits.description: What share of the five-hour and weekly windows the turn's dollars come to.

showUsd.title: Dollars
showUsd.description: The turn's cost at API prices, as the session's ledger counts it.

showSteps.title: Requests
showSteps.description: How many model requests the main loop made this turn.

showModel.title: Model
showModel.description: The model that answered the turn's last request.

showCache.title: Cache lifetime
showCache.description: When the main loop's prompt cache lapses: the last request of the turn plus an hour, or five minutes on extra usage.

showLimitSize.title: Window size
showLimitSize.description: A fourth row under the reply, 5ч ≈ $39 · нед ≈ $285: each window's whole size in dollars, a hundred times the shared price of a point.

usdPerPct5h.title: USD per point, five hours
usdPerPct5h.description: Price of one point of the five-hour window at API prices; the start value when autoCalibrate is on, used as is when off.

usdPerPctWeek.title: USD per point, week
usdPerPctWeek.description: Price of one point of the weekly window at API prices; the start value when autoCalibrate is on, used as is when off.

autoCalibrate.title: Learn the prices
autoCalibrate.description: Refine both prices from the moments the windows' readings move, over every session's spend.

trackModels.title: Models in the price table
trackModels.description: Comma list for /turn-meter: a versioned name (opus-5, opus-5-5) is that version; a family (opus, sonnet, haiku) is its newest version seen in the journals.
